constraints.figureJob: Show that the hard part of the visit is turning one human story into decision-ready structure, and that this work does not all need to happen live.
constraints.layout: One horizontal triptych across the middle of the slide: patient story left, translation chamber center, decision-ready structure right, with one thin callout beneath the chamber.
